_comment: Items. kind: evolution (used on a creature to evolve it), capture (thrown to catch a wild Streetmon; catchMult multiplies the catch chance, bonus applies extra against matching targets), heal, field (used from the team screen outside battle: the Escape Rope). price 0 = not sold.

items.name: Steel Case
items.description: A battered steel case with a heavy latch. Holster knows what to do with it.

items.name: Spark Plug
items.description: Makes Exhaust Fume backfire for good.

items.name: Cuffs
items.description: Standard-issue cuffs. Snap them on and hope they hold.

items.name: Crate
items.description: A reinforced shipping crate. Better than Cuffs, and the heavy, stubborn Concrete and Grind types settle in it best.

items.name: Net
items.description: A weighted throw net. Ordinary on slow targets, but fast ones (base Speed 80+) get tangled: x3.

items.name: Sludge Lure
items.description: A jar of something that smells irresistible to sewer things. x3 against Sludge types. Only sold on the black market.

items.name: Cage
items.description: A steel animal-control cage. x2.5 on anything. Only sold on the black market.

items.name: Capture Pod
items.description: A military-grade containment pod. x3 on anything. Only found in supply drops and street events.

items.name: Escape Rope
items.description: A knotted rope and a grappling hook. Use it underground (I, your team screen) to climb straight out of the sewers at the nearest manhole.

items.name: Night Net
items.description: A dark mesh net with reflective weights. x3 between dusk and dawn, ordinary in daylight.

items.name: Dive Net
items.description: A weighted fishing net. x3.5 in water (the pond, the sewer pools, the docks), ordinary on land.

items.name: Rookie Cuffs
items.description: Light training cuffs. x3 on anything lower level than your lead; ordinary otherwise.

items.name: Bodega Sandwich
items.description: Chopped cheese, extra hot sauce. Restores 30 HP to one Streetmon.

items.name: Volt Energy Drink
items.description: Tastes like a battery. Restores 80 HP to one Streetmon.

items.name: Field Medkit
items.description: Bandages, splints and something in a syringe. Fully heals one Streetmon and stops it choking.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.description: Revives a fainted Streetmon with half its HP.

items.name: Family Bucket
items.description: Fried chicken for the whole team. Restores 50 HP to every Streetmon in your party.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.description: For you, not them. Patches up 60 health.

items.name: Pepper Musk
items.description: Spray it on and wild Streetmon weaker than your lead keep away for 4 minutes.

items.name: Pheromone Bait
items.description: Crack the jar and twice as many wild Streetmon show up for 3 minutes.

items.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
items.description: Hold it tight: shiny Streetmon are three times as likely for 10 minutes.

items.name: Protein Shake
items.description: Raises one Streetmon a level on the spot.

items.name: Burner Phone
items.description: Call in a favour: the police drop one wanted star (not at five).

items.name: Repair Kit
items.description: Duct tape, a jack and a can of tyre foam. Fixes the car you're in (or the last one you drove) good as new.

items.name: Lockpick Set
items.description: Opens a locked cache or vault box without a key. Used up on the lock.
